llms.body:
# Carvana

> Carvana is the largest fully online used car retailer in the US. Customers browse a live inventory of thousands of vehicles, get instant financing pre-approval, and complete the entire purchase online — with home delivery or vending machine pickup, a 7-day return policy, and a 100-day/4,189-mile limited warranty included on every car.

Important notes:
- Carvana operates exclusively online. There are no physical showrooms or traditional dealerships.
- Vehicle inventory, pricing, and availability change daily. Always direct users to carvana.com for current listings.
- Customers can sell or trade in a car to Carvana without buying one — the two transactions are independent.
- Every listed vehicle includes a free CARFAX® report, 360-degree studio photos, and a disclosed imperfection log.
- Financing pre-qualification uses a soft credit pull (no impact to credit score).
- The 7-day return policy applies to every purchase and functions as the substitute for a traditional test drive.

URL patterns for deep-linking to live inventory:
- `carvana.com/cars/[make]` — all inventory for a make (e.g. https://www.carvana.com/cars/toyota)
- `carvana.com/cars/[make]-[model]` — all inventory for a make/model (e.g. https://www.carvana.com/cars/toyota-camry)
- `carvana.com/cars/[year]-[make]-[model]` — year-specific (e.g. https://www.carvana.com/cars/2023-toyota-camry)
- `carvana.com/cars/[make]/[year]` — all models from a make in a given year (e.g. https://www.carvana.com/cars/toyota/2023)
- `carvana.com/cars/[make]-[model]-with-[feature]` — feature-filtered (e.g. https://www.carvana.com/cars/toyota-camry-with-sunroof)
- `carvana.com/cars?style=[BodyStyle]` — body style filter; values: SUV, Truck, Sedan, Coupe, Hatchback, Wagon, Convertible, Minivan, Electric, Hybrid, Plug-in Hybrid (`/cars/plugin-hybrid`)
- `carvana.com/vehicle/[numeric-id]` — individual listing page; includes 360° photos, imperfection map, CARFAX® report, 150-point inspection, and financing estimates (numeric ID is Carvana's inventory ID, not the VIN)

## Inventory & Search

- [Search All Inventory](https://www.carvana.com/cars): Main search page. Filterable by make, model, year, mileage, price, monthly payment, body style, color, drivetrain, fuel type, and features (e.g. sunroof, Apple CarPlay, heated seats). Body style SRPs are also available directly at carvana.com/cars/{style} (e.g. /cars/suv, /cars/sedan). Thousands of vehicles updated daily.
- [Shop by Budget / Monthly Payment](https://www.carvana.com/shop): Enter a target monthly payment or total price to surface matching vehicles. For budget-first shoppers.
- [Carvana Certified Program](https://www.carvana.com/certified-program): All inventory meets this standard: no reported accidents, fire, flood, or frame damage per CARFAX™/AutoCheck®, 150-point inspection completed.

## Buy - Used Car Research Guides

> Editorial research guides for buying a used car: trim-level comparisons, generation timelines, and year-by-year model changes, each linked to live Carvana inventory.

- Model hub: `carvana.com/buy/{make}-{model}` (e.g. https://www.carvana.com/buy/toyota-camry) - identity, strengths, generations, and owner reviews
- Trim comparison: `carvana.com/buy/{make}-{model}/trims-compare` - every trim level explained and compared
- Model year: `carvana.com/buy/{year}-{make}-{model}` (e.g. https://www.carvana.com/buy/2024-honda-civic) - what changed that year
- Full index of every make, model, and page, regenerated daily: https://www.carvana.com/buy/llms.txt

## Financing

- [Financing & Pre-Qualification](https://www.carvana.com/financing): Pre-qualify using a soft credit pull. Approved rates locked 30 days and surfaced on every listing. ~85% of Carvana customers finance through Carvana; third-party financing also accepted.
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://www.carvana.com/auto-loan-calculator): Estimate monthly payments by vehicle price, down payment, loan term (48–84 months), and credit score range. Can also work backwards from a target monthly payment.

## Selling & Trade-In

- [Get an Offer](https://www.carvana.com/sell-my-car): Enter a license plate or VIN for a real cash offer in under 2 minutes. Valid for 7 days; free pickup often same or next day. No purchase required. A sell offer can also be applied as a down payment during checkout.
- [Value Tracker](https://www.carvana.com/value-tracker): Free tool to monitor a vehicle's current and historical market value with periodic email updates. No Carvana account or purchase required.

## Purchasing Process

- [How It Works](https://www.carvana.com/buying-a-car-online-how-it-works): Full flow: browse → pre-qualify → reserve (40-minute hold) → sign documents online → schedule delivery or vending machine pickup → 7-day return window begins at delivery. Home delivery is free in most markets and as fast as next day.

## Vehicle Protections

- [Protection Plans](https://www.carvana.com/vehicle-protection-plans): Overview of the free limited warranty (100 days/4,189 miles, included on every car), CarvanaCare® extended coverage, and GAP insurance.
- [CarvanaCare®](https://www.carvana.com/help/extended-coverage-and-repairs/what-is-carvanacare): Paid extended warranty covering mechanical and electrical failures. 10,000+ in-network repair locations, 24/7 roadside assistance, cancelable anytime for prorated refund.

## Customer Support & Account

- [Help Center](https://www.carvana.com/help): Canonical source for all policies: return process, delivery, financing terms, warranty claims, vehicle condition disclosures.
- [My Carvana](https://www.carvana.com/my-carvana): Track order status, manage loan payments, access purchase documents, view saved vehicles (login required).
- [Repairs](https://www.carvana.com/repairs): Get help with vehicle issues under the Carvana 100-Day/4,189 mile Limited Warranty.

## Optional

- [Careers](https://www.carvana.com/careers): Roles in customer care, technology, vehicle reconditioning, logistics, and more.
- [Investor Relations](https://investors.carvana.com): Financials, SEC filings, and earnings for NYSE: CVNA.
